header.description: Furnish students with an overview of the different branches of philosophy (primarily western philosophy). In the process, the student will make the acquaintance of epistemology, metaphysics, logic, ethics, philosophy of religion and more. A major focus of the course: to remove the false mystique surrounding philosophy and to give the student a clear grounding in the essentials of the discipline.

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: Demonstrate knowledge of the broad areas of philosophy.

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: Identify the major problems of philosophy.

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: First hand understanding of different branches of philosophy- Indian Philosophy, Ethics, Epistemology, Formal Logic.

outcomes.label: CO4
outcomes.raw_text: Develop an understanding of methodologies and styles of doing philosophy.
